Package edu.mit.rocket_team.instrument

package edu.mit.rocket_team.instrument
Engineering-unit sensor adapters with firmware filtering, zeroing and integration. Sensor X is the longitudinal FC axis; gyro rates are degrees per second with negative-X roll. Pressure is hPa, temperature Celsius and heights metres. These measured values are distinct from simulator truth.
